Advisory only (test-coverage lane): CHK-001:edge is proven via a deterministic standalone reproduction of the exact activeSandboxes Set + process.on(exit) sweep mechanism, because selfcheck-m3 has no fault hook to force a genuine sub-check fail() without editing the file; verified by code comparison to be structurally identical to the shipped implementation.
pitfalls: (1) The DEV->TEST validate runs 41 commands including the slow selfcheck-m3; under machine load it can exceed the default 300s idle watchdog (LATTICE_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS) and get force-exited. Re-run validate with LATTICE_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS raised (e.g. 1800000) and, if a validate was force-exited, remove the stale lock dir .lattice/locks/validation/<story>.lock (a mkdir dir containing holder.json) after confirming its pid is dead. (2) Running the three REVIEW reviewers in parallel can race on review_run_start/review_pass_set so one lane's pass may not persist; re-run that lane solo to record it cleanly. (3) selfcheck-m3.mjs and the resume-capable run-batch.mjs only existed on B-f511's branch, so this follow-up story was created only AFTER B-f511 merged to main (51c68420b), keeping the diff a clean ~53-line delta.
